title: Insight Temporal Operation v1
description: Declarative, versioned temporal analytical operation (#73). Applying it to a temporal Analytical Artifact yields a derived Analytical Artifact whose spec.hash is the SHA-256 of this spec's canonical JSON. Operations describe how values moved; they never assert why. An external producer (for example DuckDB) may implement the same operations and emit the same derived artifact shape.

minSegment.description: change point minimum segment length, default 3

x-semantics.cagr: (last/first)^(1/years)-1 over first and last recorded windows; non-positive endpoints are missing
x-semantics.rolling_mean: mean of the last window values; any missing window makes the result missing
x-semantics.rolling_delta: current minus the value window steps earlier
x-semantics.lagged_comparison: Pearson coefficient of series[t] and reference[t-lag] for lag in [-maxLag, maxLag]; at least 3 pairs
x-semantics.before_after: means before and from breakPeriod and their difference
x-semantics.cohort_comparison: each cohortDimension series indexed to its own first recorded window = 100
x-semantics.control_comparison: change of the selected series minus change of the reference series around breakPeriod
x-semantics.anomaly_candidate: 0.6745*(x-median)/MAD; flagged above threshold; needs 5 recorded windows
x-semantics.change_point_candidate: best single mean-shift split by SSE; score = 1 - SSE_split/SSE_total

x-missing: Missing results and unreported windows stay missing (never zero) and propagate as missing with a quality flag.
